title: delete removes metadata and storage object
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / XSUAA / HANA Cloud / S3
testCommand: Browser Control authenticated exact attachment DELETE plus Cloud Foundry HANA task 31 readback
actualResult: The exact authenticated attachment DELETE returned HTTP 204. The S3 provider returned HTTP 204 for object deletion, and HANA task 31 read back zero rows for both the exact attachment and BUG-0016 attachments. BUG-0016 remained PENDING_ASSIGNMENT with 0 comments and 2 notifications.
assertions: The exact authorized DELETE returned HTTP 204.
The S3 DeleteObject provider response was HTTP 204.
HANA readback reported exact attachment count 0 and BUG-0016 attachment count 0.
BUG-0016 status, comments and notifications remained unchanged.
limitations: A separate audit defect was exposed: direct active attachment DELETE created no delete HistoryEvent; history stayed at 5 with only the earlier Added attachment event. The Fiori table also failed to render the attachment. HANA Cloud auto-stopped during the first post-delete readback and was restarted; the final readiness gate and task 31 readback passed.
